prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create an exceptionally beautiful image for a contemporary premium pet photography and memories website. Prioritise aesthetic impact over literal app-output realism. The pet must look alive, sweet and naturally expressive, with believable anatomy and finely resolved fur. No human body, no human hands, no extra limbs, no stock-photo props clutter, no sepia filter, no brown vintage room, no app interface, no watermark, no logos. No lettering unless explicitly specified. Full bleed, no outer border. A slender elegant ruddy Abyssinian cat looking around an oversized sculptural pale pink calla lily, lavender backdrop, pale yellow diffuse light. Fine-art surreal botanical fashion photography, beautiful amber eyes and sculptural large ears, clean composition, no text. Intended final composition 900:1200; keep face, ears and important artwork comfortably within the central safe area for a small crop.
